versions.name: 율리안 로젠펠트
versions.camera: slightly elevated diagonal view, subject on right
versions.action: 기스 난 중갑의 체중을 실어 전열 한 곳을 돌파한다
versions.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Ercedia RPG cinematic ultimate art, ONE illustration.
Reference images are SAME character identity and outfit designs, not poses to copy. Preserve exact face, age, gender, eyes, hair, physique, clothing, faction emblems and equipment visible in references. Character 율리안 로젠펠트 / ER-CORE-007. Text setting: 186cm, 붉은 갈색 단발과 회청색 눈, 매부리코, 기스 난 은백 중갑과 자주색 외투.
Approved technique: 장미 쇄진 · 결전식. Draw action: 기스 난 중갑의 체중을 실어 전열 한 곳을 돌파한다. Skill category: attack. Effect: 무기·손·접점 한 곳에 힘을 응축한 단일 발동. 짧은 검광 또는 국소 마나 효과.. Element: NONE: non-elemental physical/mana phenomenon; do not invent fire/lightning/holy magic. Limits: 시야·사거리·자세와 실제 지형에 제한되며 자동 적중·절대 방어가 아니다..
Regional context: 벨로아, 농경·기병·기사 문화; terrain 요새 연쇄와 난민 유입, 군량 소모. Background is an understated appropriate medieval fantasy environment supporting action, no extra named locations invented.
LOW restrained tier: a single narrow concentrated effect at hand/weapon/contact point. No full body aura, no enormous beams, no elemental storm. Proficient yet contained.
Camera: slightly elevated diagonal view, subject on right. Dynamic weight shift matching technique, visible hands properly connected to weapon/tool; defense/support stays defense/support, never converted into destruction. Keep face prominent and readable for an eventual face crop (face width roughly 16-22% of entire canvas). Focused, character-appropriate emotion, not automatic smile. Not front-facing standing portrait.
Style: polished 2D anime/cartoon fantasy in SAME visual quality as references, clean linework, rich readable game colors and painterly cinematic lighting. Background and effects fully painted as OPAQUE image. Wide horizontal 16:9 PNG ideally 1920x1080 or larger. Safe edges for face and key weapon/gesture. No text, lettering, numbers, logos, UI, frames, watermark or split panels. ONE character only. Absolutely SOLO character: no enemy bodies, hands, crowds, silhouettes, or extra figures. Do not draw an opponent, the threat remains outside the picture.  Weapon and equipment held naturally at the grip, no duplicate swords or extra limbs.  The knight uses the sword through the configured main technique. SHOW ACTUAL SWORD ACTION, at high tier both gloved hands naturally grip the sword hilt and slash, thrust or hold a strong guard as specified. Never replace sword action with a generic open-palm magic casting pose. Different blade angle and body action from the low-tier image. No telekinetic levitation of rocks. Ambient dust must be a result of physical weapon impact.
versions.visual_notes: 참조 원화의 얼굴·안경 또는 흉터·복식과 문장을 비교함. 칼자루를 잡은 검 동작이며 고단계는 더 넓은 검 궤적. 다른 인물·문자 없음. 최종 사용자 검수 대기.
versions.processing: minimal edge crop to exact 16:9; no resizing, no background removal
